summary: Lessons captured during initial build — Bulgarian Cyrillic invoice/protocol extraction system. Useful for future maintainers, code reviewers, and AI agents working on this codebase.

tool_selection.title: Vision-LLM beats generic OCR for structured documents
tool_selection.context: First implementation used EasyOCR + img2table. Result on a real Bulgarian invoice: '3.998,00' came out as 'З.ggb', column boundaries broken, decimal separator dropped on 4,75 → 475.
tool_selection.lesson: For invoices/forms, vision models like Gemini with Pydantic structured output produce near-perfect extraction directly into typed JSON. The model 'understands' the document semantics, not just pixels.
tool_selection.metric: Gemini 2.5 Flash: ~$0.0003/invoice, free tier covers 20 req/day on this model. Math validation passed to the cent on 4 cross-checks.
tool_selection.anti_pattern: Picking the lowest-friction local tool by default ('no API key, no sudo') rather than the right-fit tool for the document class.

tool_selection.title: Always present the full landscape of options
tool_selection.context: Initially proposed only generic OCR and PDF-text tools. User flagged that DeepSeek-OCR, vision-LLMs, and specialized invoice APIs (Mindee, Rossum, Veryfi, Klippa, Affinda, Nanonets) were missing from the discussion.
tool_selection.lesson: For document extraction tasks, four categories must be on the table from the start: (1) vision-LLMs with structured output, (2) modern open-source vision models, (3) specialized invoice APIs, (4) generic OCR + table detection. Generic OCR alone is the WEAKEST default for invoices.

architecture.title: Pipeline of fallback extractors, not single-tool choice
architecture.decision: EXTRACTORS = [Gemini → pdfplumber → EasyOCR+img2table]. Each extractor declares can_handle(); pipeline tries them in order; falls through on exception.
architecture.rationale: Documents come in many forms (born-digital PDF, scanned PDF, photo, tilted image). One extractor cannot serve all. System must degrade gracefully when primary fails (e.g. Gemini 503/quota).

architecture.title: Per-client registry as compounding accuracy layer
architecture.decision: SQLite-backed SupplierRegistry stores known supplier facts (name, address, EIK, VAT, IBAN, bank, BIC). enrich() applies registry over extraction; record() updates registry from extraction.
architecture.rationale: OCR/LLM make different mistakes each run. A persistent registry of corrected facts means the same hallucination is auto-fixed silently on every subsequent run from that supplier. This is the Controlisy moat — the OCR engine is replaceable; the per-client memory is the differentiator.
trust_order: Registry (highest — verified by past human review)
Regex on raw text (low — only safe patterns like IBAN with checksum, NEVER party identification)

architecture.title: Validation as last-line defense
architecture.decision: Five-layer validation: (1) ЕИК format check, (2) IBAN length+checksum, (3) Σ line items = net amount, (4) subtotal − discount = net, (5) net + VAT = total + total − paid = remaining.
architecture.rationale: OCR and LLMs both produce silently-wrong numbers. Math cross-checks catch the majority of digit-level errors regardless of which engine produced them. ЕИК/IBAN format checks catch transcription errors. Validation surfaces issues to a human review queue rather than letting bad data flow into accounting.

architecture.title: Conservative fallback parser
architecture.decision: text_parser.py only extracts unambiguous fields (IBAN with checksum, labeled invoice number). Does NOT populate supplier/customer fields from regex.
architecture.rationale: Distinguishing 'Изпълнител' vs 'Получател' from raw OCR text is unreliable across templates. Two attempts at heuristic parsing produced wrong supplier identification (MOL signature mistaken for supplier name; left-to-right OCR order mistaken for semantic order). Better to leave fields empty than fill them wrong.

bulgarian_domain_facts.fact: ЕИК can be 9 (legal entity), 10 (ЕГН — sole proprietor / natural person), or 13 (БУЛСТАТ) digits
bulgarian_domain_facts.implication: All three lengths must validate as OK. Initial regex only accepted 9/13 — missed 10-digit suppliers like the EuroFaktura demo.

bulgarian_domain_facts.fact: ИН по ДДС (VAT number) is OPTIONAL — only present for VAT-registered entities
bulgarian_domain_facts.implication: The Gemini prompt must NOT instruct 'always extract BG prefix' — non-VAT-registered suppliers have only ЕИК, no BG-prefixed VAT number. Hallucinating a BG number from ЕИК would be incorrect.

bulgarian_domain_facts.fact: Decimal separator is comma (1.999,00); thousands separator is dot or space (36.265,00 or 36 265,00)
bulgarian_domain_facts.implication: Must be normalized to plain float internally. Output back to comma format only at presentation layer (Excel).
VAT breakdown commonly has 1-2 entries. Schema models this as a list, not fixed pair.

bulgarian_domain_facts.fact: Чл. 117 (Article 117) protocols — self-charged VAT — are a Bulgarian-specific document class
bulgarian_domain_facts.implication: Distinct from regular invoices in legal handling. Out of scope for v0.1 but noted for roadmap.

bugs_caught_during_build.description: Registry empty when supplier had only VAT number, no separate ЕИК — record() returned early. Fix: derive ЕИК from BG-prefixed VAT digits.
IBAN regex matched VAT numbers as malformed IBANs (BG123456789 looks like a short IBAN). Fix: regex requires 4 letters after BG\d{2}, matching real IBAN structure.
page_count hardcoded to 1 in Gemini and EasyOCR extractors. Fix: derive from PDF for born-digital.
Retry message showed '1/3' but actually had 4 attempts. Fix: total = retries + 1.
registry variable scope was inside `if doc.invoice` block, fragile if flow changed. Fix: always create registry.
ЕИК regex did not support 10-digit ЕГН (Bulgarian sole proprietors). Fix: accept 9, 10, or 13.
ЕИК regex matched invoice numbers (10 digits like '0000000321') as ЕИК. Fix: validate typed fields when InvoiceData present; require label (ЕИК/ПИК/BG) for text fallback.
Per-client learning never engaged on fallback paths (pdfplumber, EasyOCR don't produce InvoiceData). Fix: text_parser fills minimal InvoiceData after extraction.
text_parser swapped supplier and customer (assigned first ЕИК as supplier based on text order). Fix: parser does NOT populate parties from regex.
text_parser captured МОЛ from signature line as supplier name. Same fix as #9.
registry.record() mutated input invoice by writing to inv.supplier.eik. Fix: do not mutate caller's object.
registry.enrich() mutated input BEFORE calling model_copy. Fix: model_copy(deep=True) FIRST, work on the copy.
Registry never filled missing fields — `if known is None or seen is None: continue` skipped all None-known cases. Fix: when known is None and seen is non-None, AUTO-FILL via UPDATE.
`except (NoExtractorFound, Exception)` was redundant — Exception catches everything.
gemini_extractor crashed if response.parsed was None (safety filter, malformed JSON). Fix: explicit None check with clear error message.
IBAN in raw text was NOT validated when invoice existed but had no IBAN field — pure miss. Fix: text-fallback IBAN scan runs whenever invoice.iban is None.
Schema description on Party.eik still said '9 or 13 digit' after BG-1 was learned. Fix: update to '9, 10, or 13'.

design_principles_emerged: Don't pollute the registry with low-confidence data — better to learn nothing than to learn wrong.
Every extractor is replaceable; the canonical schema (InvoiceData) is the spine.
Validation is independent of extraction — math checks work on any number, no matter who produced it.
Trust hierarchy explicit: registry > typed extraction > regex on text. Never invert.
Cost-aware routing: free fast paths (pdfplumber for born-digital) before paid (Gemini), but Gemini ranked first for invoices because the structured output saves work downstream.
Fallback gracefully on failure (503/quota), surface the degradation in extraction_method field of output.
open_questions: Multi-page invoices: tested only single-page so far. Schema and pipeline support multi-page, but no real sample yet.
Чл. 117 protocols: prompt mentions them but no validation rules specific to self-charged VAT.

real_world_batch_findings_2026_05_10.context: First real-world batch on 20 diverse Bulgarian invoices from 17+ suppliers (АЖД, Агритоп, Албис, Алфа Комерс, Биохем, Вероникс, ВиК Габрово, Виваком, ГВ Агри, Грейнстор, Д.Д.Д, Дисиком, Еконт, Електрохолд, Елмикс, ЗП Цветан Стефанов, Иванов 13, Манев 09, Ненко Трифонов).

real_problems_found.problem: Gemini hallucinates IBAN letters (~3 of 17 = ~18% error rate)
real_problems_found.detection: IBAN mod-97 checksum validator catches all instances
real_problems_found.fix: Pipeline cross-checks Gemini IBAN against text_parser regex match. If Gemini IBAN fails checksum and text_parser finds a valid one, prefer text_parser's. Otherwise keep Gemini's value with the warning surfaced.

real_problems_found.problem: Gemini sometimes doubles line items by including sub-totals as separate rows
real_problems_found.example: Виваком: Σ редове (74.44) ≠ нетна (37.22), разлика +37.22 (exactly the line total again — sub-item duplication)
real_problems_found.fix: Surfaces as validation error, flags for human review. Auto-fix risky — sub-items can be legitimate detail rows in some templates.

real_problems_found.example: Биохем 06.08.25.pdf: extracted 'Номер: 146' which looks like a partial
real_problems_found.detection: Manual review by user — no automated check (real invoice numbers can be 3-digit too)
real_problems_found.fix: Cannot auto-fix without re-extracting. Note in user-facing report when number is suspiciously short (<6 chars).

real_problems_found.problem: Some born-digital PDFs (Д.Д.Д, Дисиком) with text layer fall through to pdfplumber path
real_problems_found.cause: Gemini occasionally returns 503 even after retries. With env var GEMINI_RETRY_DELAYS=5,15, two retries allow recovery for transient cases but not for sustained server load.
real_problems_found.detection: extraction_method column in summary shows 'pdfplumber' instead of 'gemini:...'
real_problems_found.fix: Re-run only the affected files with paid Gemini tier (no quota throttling) for production-grade completeness.

performance_metrics.throughput: 20 files in ~3 minutes with mostly Gemini path (~9 sec per Gemini call avg)

lessons_extracted: Validation layer is the single most important component — caught EVERY real error (5 issues across 20 files), no false positives, no silent failures.
IBAN hallucination is the dominant Gemini failure mode (more than supplier/customer mix-ups, more than digit errors). Post-processing IBAN cross-check should be standard.
Math validation is more powerful than format validation — caught 2 multi-cent errors that no field-level check could detect.
Bug 24 (env loading timing) was a $0.30 lesson — the first 247-file batch used wrong (tighter-quota) model. Always read env-driven config lazily, not at __init__ time.
Bug 25 (Excel writer ignored tables when invoice present) was a 240-file data loss — when text_parser provides sparse InvoiceData, the original tables MUST also be written. Now: writer keeps both.
Free-tier flash-lite (1500/day) handles 247 invoices easily within quota IF retries are bounded (GEMINI_RETRY_DELAYS=5,15 works well — total 20s overhead per failed call vs 52s with old defaults).
